## About
Dolan Inc. started with Jack Dolan Sr. Born and raised in New Brunswick, Jack worked for local plumbers after serving in the United States Navy during World War II, then struck out on his own. Working out of his home, he built a reputation for quality workmanship, reliability and integrity in Franklin Township and the surrounding towns.
Jack and his wife and partner, Mary, raised their family while growing a loyal customer base. His dream was a facility with more service options and a bath and kitchen showroom for remodeling. We continue his vision today, handling plumbing, heating, cooling, electric and remodeling for homes and businesses.
Neighbors rate us 4.7 from 543 Google reviews. One longtime customer wrote that Dolan is the only plumbing company he has used more than once.

## Services
- Plumbing Services: Plumbing maintenance, installation and repairs for your home or business. One reviewer called Dolan especially knowledgeable with older houses and plumbing.
- Drain Cleaning: Clogged drains cleared by a team trained to do the job right the first time.
- Water Heater Services: Installation, replacement and repair, so hot water is always there when you need it.
- Heating Services: Repair, service and installation for boilers, furnaces and heat pumps.
- Cooling Services: AC service and repair, air duct repair and AC installation.
- Electric Services: Electrical installation and repair, from surge protection to recessed lighting.
- Remodeling: Bath and kitchen remodeling, with a showroom to help you plan. One reviewer had her bathroom gutted to the studs and rebuilt.
- Dolan Home Care Club: Regularly scheduled inspections and routine maintenance of your heating and cooling systems, with preferential scheduling. (As little as $109 per year (1 year heat only))

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. Emergency Services are available 24/7.

Q: Do I need an appointment to visit the showroom?
A: Yes, the showroom is by appointment, so give the office a call before you come by.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Yes, we offer Wells Fargo Financing. One reviewer said Anne guided her through her financing application.

Q: How does the Home Care Club work?
A: You choose the number of preventative maintenance calls per year and what you want covered. Your choices set the cost of your plan.
